claims.evidence: Witness only saw boxed packaging with the text “FRANCISODETOIA” partially visible; no clear view of the actual machine type.
No condition of the actual product is visible because it is fully boxed and wrapped.
No test/print sample or view of the copier’s output was shown.
No counter reading or internal page count evidence is visible through the packaging.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No access to drum/toner status or jam history; packaging only.

risks.risk: The item may not be a multifunctional copier (could be a different product or a generic/incorrectly labeled box).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the actual device showing brand/model nameplate and control panel (or a close-up of the exact model/serial label).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown boxed item with no confirmed function; treat as not verified for copier use.

risks.risk: Working status is unknown (could be non-functional, faulty, or missing parts/accessories).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on and a successful test print/copy (showing paper feeding and output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a test print is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Page count and consumables claims may be false (counter reset, drum/toner not actually new, or toner quality issues).
risks.proof: A photo of the machine’s counter/page meter screen and a close-up of drum/toner installation labels or part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case wear/unknown consumable life (assume drum/toner may need replacement soon).

risks.risk: Paper jam claim may be untrue (jams can occur under load or with certain paper sizes).
risks.proof: Video showing at least one full cycle: load paper, run multiple copies (e.g., 10–20), and show no jam/error codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as likely to require troubleshooting/maintenance if jams occur.

risks.risk: Accessories and completeness are unknown (power cable, USB/network cable, toner/drum packaging, manuals).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of all included items with a checklist (power cable, toner, drum, manuals, any network/USB accessories).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown bundle; assume buyer may need to source missing accessories.

risks.risk: Model/variant and specifications are unknown, affecting compatibility, driver support, and service availability in Lagos.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label and the full specification sticker (or the exact model printed on the device).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least favorable variant/unknown specs for service and parts sourcing.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the actual copier (not the box): front panel, control buttons, and the brand/model nameplate/serial label.
Send a short video: power-on, menu/counter screen, and a successful test copy/print showing output.
Show the page counter reading (or equivalent meter screen) clearly.
Show close-ups of the installed drum and toner (part numbers/labels) and confirm what is included in the box.
Show a short run of multiple copies (enough to demonstrate no paper jam and stable feeding).
Provide a photo of everything included (power cable, manuals, toner/drum, any network/USB accessories).
response.reason: The witness report shows only boxed packaging with no readable model, no view of the actual copier, and no working/test evidence. A worst-case price cannot be safely set without at least proof of what the device is and that it works.
